scope: Targeted static review of company/project/agent/issue/run/contract/interaction/admission/work-product schemas; native versus legacy runtime selection; issue create/child/idempotency/dependency/cycle/checkout/update and route authority; signed-run versus reusable-key actor attribution; cancellation/handoff gate versus locked native authority; transactional tool receipts; per-agent queue/budget admission and process-local start locking versus deliberately internal project admission; completion-contract revision/hash and agent-claim policy, durable evidence, required exact-target quality review and status CAS/effects; stop write revocation, selected executor settlement, live owner/checkpoint/ambiguous native recovery and finalization; activity/delivery records and coordinator; versioned document writes; representative CLI/UI issue list/detail/optimistic helpers and database startup. Selected recovery and quality-review test assertion bodies read, not executed. Not every-line, all providers/plugins/transports/imports/admin/budget settlement/workspace finalization/deployment/accessibility/performance/production concurrency certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Durable company/project/issue hierarchy and child origin fingerprint/idempotency key; parent and reuse-policy validation. Native create_task explicitly blockParentUntilDone false; helper supports optional child-to-parent blocker.
lifecycle_review.select: Dependency readiness distinguishes done from cancelled and pending workspace finalization; cycle traversal. Route checks project pause/access/self checkout/assignment/run and workspace generation before issue service.
lifecycle_review.claim: Conditional SQL checkout on state/assignee/execution owner and compatible adoption yields conflict for other owner. Native tool context locks and validates current running native run, company, agent, issue and assignment. Ordinary route ownership has unassigned/idle/watchdog/override branches; cancellation gate is not universal run validator.
lifecycle_review.progress: Revisioned documents with base revision checks, work products, results, work assessments, activity and interaction/delivery records; native business mutation and replay receipt in same transaction. Ordinary checkout audit follows primary mutation; transaction boundaries differ.
lifecycle_review.review: Revision/hash contract; server evidence classifier distinguishes provider proposal and durable evidence. Default non-human_only/non-not_creator policy can use agent_claim_policy. Optional required quality review binds approval to exact current non-plan output revision/asset hash and disallows agent removal.
lifecycle_review.complete: Native arbiter checks blockers, required quality review, failure/attention/remaining policy and pending undelivered child wake. Agent-claim can finish without all independent evidence/verification pass. Status decision replay/current-state/version fencing and keyed parent/dependent wake effects. Child lineage/pending wake guard is not accepted join for all children.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Stop transaction locks issue/run and records executionCancellation write revocation before waiting for executor. Native pending recovery can report honest pending conflict; local adapter termination differs. Cannot reverse external side effects. Shared gate permits missing agent/run and does not reject every terminal/missing matching run.
lifecycle_review.recover: Checkpoint identity binds company/agent/issue/run/session/runner; live owner prevents takeover and exhausted unknown history holds. Finalization uses retained result/contract and reconciler. Native receipt recovery assertions model missing wake replay without repeat business mutation. Per-agent start lock is process-local, project admission remains internal until maximum enforcement; no cluster-wide capacity guarantee or all provider retries certification.
